{{Quote|I am the Mystic Nelom-Wa. I put the child in the Three. A crying babe. Unfit for everything. To replace a great leader. The vision was clear. The plague came. The Three died. We called back a great leader to reform the Three.|Writings of Nelom-Wa|<ref name="Imp March of Time">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|March of Time|Voss}}</ref>}}
The '''Writings of Nelom-Wa''' were composed by a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] named [[Nelom-Wa]] many years before his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the galactic society. The writings were etched on a pillar erected outside the [[Shrine of Healing]] in the [[Old Paths]]. A traveling hero recorded the writings and gave them to [[Ker-Na]].
